messages:
priya: Heads up — I'll be at EuroConnex in Berlin next week. Anyone got affordable hotels near the Messe? Budget around €120/night. Also debating train vs Uber from BER; any late-night safety tips? And charger/adapter hacks? :luggage:

alex: Motel One near Ostbahnhof worked well for me — quiet, clean, ~20–25min to the venue by S-Bahn, usually under €120 if you book early.

maya: For trains, from BER take the FEX or S9 to Hauptbahnhof then S3/S9 depending on where you're headed. Expect 30–40 min total. Trains are cheaper and faster during the day.

jorge: If you're arriving late with a lot of stuff, Uber can be worth it. For solo travelers during the day the train is fine. If it's after 11pm and you want fewer transfers, grab a ride.

emily: Pack a tiny multi-plug + one USB-C brick so you can charge two things at once. Powerbank tip: keep it under 100Wh so you don't run into gate issues. Liquids in one clear quart bag and label anything that smells suspicious (kidding). :sweat_smile:

rachel: Check Airbnb for a studio near the canal — sometimes cheaper for 3+ nights. Also ask hotels for early check-in if you arrive morning, small requests usually granted.

priya: Thanks all — any laundromat recs near the venue? Flying carry-on only so might need a quick wash mid-trip.

maya: There's a 24/7 self-service laundromat by Warschauer Str. Took me 40 minutes last time.

alex: Conference swag tip: bring a small foldable tote, not one of those giant shopper bags, you'll be carrying it all day otherwise. :grimacing:

travel-bot: Reminder: check in 24h before flight; BER forecast looks like light showers on Wed-Thu, pack a slim rain jacket.

jorge: Quick packing checklist (save this snippet):

```
Carry-on:
- 1x 20L daypack
- 2 outfits + light sweater
- toiletries in clear bag (<100ml each)
- EU adapter + 1x 65W USB-C charger
- Powerbank <100Wh (carry-on)
- Reusable water bottle (empty at security)
```

emily: Also, DB app is great for live platform updates but keep a fallback photo of your ticket if you prefer paper.

priya: Saved — huge help. Who wants to meet Wed 9am for coffee near the venue? @alex @maya

alex: I'm in :coffee:

maya: Count me in!
